name: cost-panel-cache-ratio
description: The `/cost` panel's cache accounting, opened the way a person opens it (the composer's own `/cost` command) on a Codex session that reports cumulative cached input. The panel must draw the derived cache hit rate as its own row, the fresh/cache-read proportion bar in the same input unit as the ratio, and the provider's cache-accounting statement; the cache rows must read as a breakdown of input rather than as addends. Every assertion reads the panel's own `data-cost-*` declarations, never translated prose.
